inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala is right to urge people to reject these proposed amendments. If they are designed to keep President Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030, this is not just a political maneuver—it is an attempt by those at the top to weaken the public’s ability to hold power accountable. Ordinary people already have too little influence over decisions that shape their lives; changing the rules to prolong a leader’s tenure would further narrow their voice. Zimbabwe needs an open debate and institutions that protect everyone’s right to choose who governs them.
